title: Beatrix and the Spire
author: J. M. Reyes
blurb: Sebastian Okonkwo, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
